## Summary

Describe the user-visible outcome and the reason for the change.

## Validation

- [ ] I added or updated tests for changed behavior, or explained why none are needed.
- [ ] I ran the relevant formatting, lint, test, documentation, and release checks.
- [ ] I documented compatibility, migration, and release impact where applicable.

List the exact commands, environments, and results used for validation.

## Public/private boundary

- [ ] This change contains no secrets, customer telemetry, private repository URLs,
      or deterministic-simulation source code, configurations, logs, and evidence.

Keep deterministic-simulation adapters and retained campaign evidence in the private
simulation repository. Public documentation may summarize outcomes without exposing
private implementation details.
